name: abdm-integrators-assistant
description: Agent skills for ABDM integration from the ABDM Developer Portal, compiled from the Catalogue. One skill per module: abdm-gateway, abdm-m1 to abdm-m4 on the provider side, abdm-p1 (P1 Registration and login), abdm-p2 (P2 Consents Management), abdm-p3 (P3 Subscription) and abdm-p4 (P4 Locker) inside a PHR application, abdm-scan-and-register, abdm-scan-and-pay, abdm-record-share, and abdm-fhir for NRCES compliant bundles. Each carries its work as sections that load on demand: scaffold builds the module flow by flow against the sandbox, integrate holds the calls and headers, debug lists every code the specification's examples return and walks a failed call to a fix proved by the original call succeeding. Every step names the operation it came from, and every response shape is unconfirmed until the sandbox has answered. Three commands open the work from the terminal: /abdm-preflight checks what must be true before any call, /abdm-prove-encryption settles the RSA padding before a flow is built on it, and /abdm-decode-error turns a response into its code and the most likely fix. Three agents plan above the skills: abdm-integration-agent takes a goal such as becoming an HIU and sequences the module skills by what each requires and produces, abdm-call-debugger takes one failing call to a fix and verifies it by the original call succeeding, and fhir-compliance-agent validates and repairs the bundles a codebase emits until the validator passes. Every skill declares its domain, what it requires and produces, and that it never orchestrates.
